This week in review -

The macro picture

Yields kept climbing. The 10-year Treasury pushed past 5.3% and the 30-year topped 5.7%, while oil spiked 5% after President Trump said he doesn’t want a deal with Iran to end the war. In between, the S&P 500 hit a record high and Nvidia reached an all-time high, closing in on a $6 trillion market cap. Then OpenAI-linked stocks sank after Reuters reported OpenAI told investors its September annualized revenue was closer to $50B than the ~$70B suggested earlier - Nvidia fell 3% and Oracle 6% on the news. The haul includes a claimed proof of the Unique Games Conjecture, which whole careers were built around. Mathematicians say the write-ups are close to unreadable without AI help.
